spans.s: भक्किका f. A cricket.
भक्त (I) a. (f. क्ता) 1. Allotted, distributed; 2. divided; 3. served, worshipped; 4. occupied with; 5. attached to, devoted to, loyal, faithful, Bg.ix.34; 6. dressed, cooked, (pp. of भज् q.v.).
भक्त (II) m. A worshipper, a faithful attendant, a votary, Bg.iv.3, vii.23, ix.31.
भक्त (III) n. 1. A share, a portion; 2. food, nourishment; 3. boiled rice, any eatable grain boiled with water.
